SELECT mr.id AS matching_request_id, mr.requester_id,
 mr.preferred_companion_gender, mr.pace, mr.budget_min, mr.budget_max,
 FALSE AS candidate_budget_available,
 (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(t.theme) FROM matching_requests_themes t WHERE t.matching_request_id=mr.id) AS themes
 FROM matching_requests mr
 WHERE mr.id=%(matching_request_id)s AND mr.requester_id=%(requester_id)s
candidates:
SELECT p.user_id, p.gender, p.pace,
 (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(t.theme) FROM matching_profile_themes t WHERE t.matching_profile_id=p.id) AS themes
 FROM matching_profiles p JOIN users u ON u.id=p.user_id
 WHERE p.is_active=TRUE AND p.user_id<>%(requester_id)s
 AND p.gender IS NOT NULL AND p.pace IS NOT NULL
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM matching_profile_themes t WHERE t.matching_profile_id=p.id)
 AND p.user_id>%(after_user_id)s
 ORDER BY p.user_id LIMIT %(candidate_limit)s
